stem: The ability of the Grand Banks cod fishery to sustain intensive cod harvesting for many years gave it a reputation for ____ that deceived even scientifically sophisticated observers.

The title of Lee’s 1964 textbook, A History of For Eastern Art, might seem to imply that the entire subject could be encapsulated in a single work. In fact, the treatment of art across Asian cultures and over millennia could never (i)____ if it also aspired to be (ii)____.
colsZh: 可达到的；可理解的；能获得的

stem: The (i)____ in local coverage of a rabies outbreak in colonial Hanoi may be startling today, but it cannot be attributed solely to the (ii)____ of the era's journalists. Rather, before the advent of modern public health systems, (iii)____ the unpleasantness of the disease and its treatment was seen as a way to, ensure that the public remained vigilant against possible sources of contagion.
colsZh: 令人毛骨悚然的细节程度
追求轰动效应；哗众取宠

stem: Sweet's illustrations are playfully ____: the eye hops sparrowlike from leaf to leaf, uncertain where to settle.
optsZh: 令人畏惧的，望而生怯的

stem: Archer is surprisingly ____ in failing to see her subjects’ self-reported life histories for what they really are: the kinds of stories that pretty much all twenty-somethings tell.
optsZh: 缺乏原则的；不讲道德的

stem: That she was unaffected by the ____ of the feudal past was evident in the style in which she wrote of it, a style completely devoid of nostalgia.

The World Health Organization has recommended that countries use artemisinin-based combination therapies to treat malaria patients, as continued use of artemisinin monotherapies could ____ the efficacy of artemisinin, the most successful antimalarial drug available.
